categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies Tor control port integration in src/torcontrol.cpp and src/torcontrol.h, which is covered under Tor, I2P, and CJDNS integrations.
categories.rationale: Reduces log noise by suppressing spurious Tor connection failure warnings on default node configurations. Since v32, unconfigured nodes log around 18 warning and refusal lines per hour in debug.log even when the user never enabled Tor.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Utils excludes logging or settings changes whose point is one area's behavior, which in this case is Tor control.
categories.rationale: This change specifically targets Tor control connection logging rather than shared logging infrastructure.
